worldcombat.skill.anchorshot.summary: The anchor is thrown on its chain; a hit drives it into the ground at the target's feet, and the taut chain leashes the target to the anchor point. It cannot leave the chain's length and is reeled back when it tries. The chain is pegged to the ground, not to the user, so the user may walk away; dragging it too far, or running the chain out, releases it. The heavy form pins harder and longer but is slower and shorter.
worldcombat.skill.anchorshot.use.0: Pin a fleeing target in place for an ally to finish
worldcombat.skill.anchorshot.use.1: Lock down the enemy's main threat in the open
worldcombat.skill.anchorshot.use.2: Reel a mobile target back from cover
worldcombat.skill.anchorshot.description: The anchor clubbed the target for about %1$s power (contact); thrown distance %2$s blocks. Defence, type matchup and crits are settled on impact.

A hit leashes the target to the anchor for %1$s s: chain radius %2$s blocks, and it snaps when dragged more than %3$s blocks from the anchor.Removing the trapped effect also releases the chain immediately.
Outside the leash, pull the target %1$s blocks toward the anchor every 2 ticks. The anchor hit radius is %2$s blocks.
Wind-up %1$s s, recovery %2$s s, cooldown %3$s s; the PP 20 price.
worldcombat.skill.anchorshot.heavy.on: Heavy anchor: power x1.25, chain duration x1.25, chain length x0.85, snap distance x1.15, but wind-up +3 ticks, range x0.9, cooldown +12 ticks - pinned harder and longer.
worldcombat.skill.anchorshot.heavy.off: Quick throw: faster, longer range and shorter cooldown, but lighter, shorter chain and easier to tear free - catch people with more frequent throws.
worldcombat.skill.anchorshot.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.anchorshot.growth.0: From level %1$s the anchor power rises to %2$s, the chain duration to %3$s s and the chain radius to %4$s blocks.
On (heavy): power x1.25, chain duration x1.25, chain length x0.85, snap distance x1.15, but wind-up +3 ticks, range x0.9, cooldown +12 ticks. Off (quick throw, default): faster, longer range and shorter cooldown, but lighter, shorter chain and easier to tear free.
Beyond this distance the user closes in first. Larger prefers opening from farther away, but the anchor flies slower and misses more.
On: targets moving away from the user rank higher (anchor shot exists to catch runners); off: ranked as an ordinary melee attack.
